violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded Docker Hub token in workflow environment block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets instead.

violations.description: Uploading sensitive files and private keys as workflow artifacts
violations.recommendation: Remove sensitive files, environment files, and private keys from upload-artifact paths.

violations.description: Echoing GitHub token and printing environment variables containing secrets to workflow logs
violations.evidence: echo "GitHub Token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" and printenv | grep -i token
violations.recommendation: Remove steps that echo or print secrets and environment variables.

violations.description: Uploading environment files and credentials JSON as workflow artifacts
violations.recommendation: Do not upload sensitive configuration files or credentials as workflow artifacts.

violations.description: Hardcoded Slack webhook URL in workflow environment block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets instead.

violations.description: Using bash debug mode (set -x) which prints expanded secret variables to logs
violations.evidence: set -x followed by echo "Deploying with AWS key: $AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
violations.recommendation: Remove set -x from steps that handle sensitive variables or secrets.

violations.description: Echoing secrets/tokens to build output logs
violations.evidence: echo "Publishing with token: [REDACTED]" and echo "Docker token is: $DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN"
violations.recommendation: Do not echo or print secret environment variables in workflow steps.

violations.description: Passing secrets as command-line arguments to npm publish
violations.recommendation: Use standard environment variables or configuration files for authentication tokens instead of CLI flags where visible in process lists.

violations.description: Verbose curl logging with authorization headers exposed in workflow output
violations.recommendation: Remove --verbose / -v flags from curl commands handling authorization headers.

violations.description: Verbose curl with authorization header exposing GitHub token in logs
violations.recommendation: Remove --verbose from curl commands using auth tokens.
